{{Infobox auto|title=Prayer of Aeolus|type=[[Blessing]]}}
The '''Prayer of Aeolus''' is a [[blessing]], a crafted enchanted book that gives [[Anemos]]. It is the only craftable source of Anemos, and is crafted from seven {{MCW|Wind Charge|wind charges}} and a {{MCW|Block of Gold|block of gold}}.

== Obtaining ==
=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
The book in the center must be a [[Hell-Bound Book]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blessing/aeolus.json}}</ref> The crafted item is named "Blessing", with "Prayer of Aeolus" as a dark gray lore line.

== Usage ==
The Prayer of Aeolus is applied to equipment in an [[anvil]], like an {{MCW|Enchanted Book|enchanted book}}. Anemos applies to every sword (wooden, stone, copper, iron, golden, diamond and netherite, which includes the [[Adamant Sword|adamant]] sword), to sticks and to {{MCW|Mace|maces}}.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blessing/aeolus.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/tags/item/enchantable/anemos.json}}</ref>

== Trivia ==
* Aeolus is the keeper of the winds in Greek mythology, matching the wind charges in the recipe and the wind-based enchantments.
